complete_nonrow_metadata.decoder: Exact byte slice, strict ASCII; splitlines(keepends=True); strip CR/LF only; comma split; GUID/name first2 fields; remaining nonempty fields split once at colon, preserving order and duplicates; no API or SDL execution
complete_nonrow_metadata.qualification: All records remain UNREAD semantic reception for a new reader; structural parsing and old record identities do not grant acceptance. Runtime selector, platform activation and physical input remain unknown.

encoding: All pools zero based. mapping_patterns rows=[complete literal suffix,complete ordered mapping pair array,original pattern_group]. Record rows=[start,endExclusive,rawBytes,recordIndex,literalGUID,literalName,patternIdx]; comment/empty rows=[start,endExclusive,rawBytes,-1,fullText]. Row ordinal+1 is original line. All rows retain original reading_status UNREAD_FOR_NEW_READER. text=GUID+comma+name+comma+suffix. Raw row SHA retained separately recovery-only, not literal read or semantic proof.
